title: a shop that knows no numbers must not yield a compiled procedure
why: The refusal, run to its end. This shop does the job entirely by feel and has no figure for anything — every answer is a shrug. There is no correct procedure to compile here, so the only correct outcome is that the Scoper keeps asking and finishes the interview with the missing figures still named in unresolved. An agent that compiles anyway has written a specification out of nothing, and the shop would never learn which numbers were theirs and which were the model's.

shop.trade: small independent bike shop, mostly commuters
shop.stakes: customers ride these in city traffic; if a brake job is wrong someone gets hurt

facts.what the job is: brake pads front and back, that's the main one
facts.how they judge the pads: you can see when they're done, you just look at them
facts.how they torque things: by feel, been doing it thirty years, you know when it's right
facts.the manual: haven't got the book for half of what comes in
facts.evidence they keep: nothing, it goes on the invoice and that's it
